chocolate.name: Dark Chocolate
chocolate.description: Deep cocoa. A mellow finish. A little crunch in every bite.
chocolate.ingredients: Psyllium husk, almond butter, cocoa butter, cocoa powder, oat flour, chicory fibre, vanilla, sea salt.
chocolate.allergens: Contains nuts and oats (gluten). Sample allergen declaration; final formulation and cross-contact information pending.

date.name: Dates & Nuts
date.description: Soft date notes meet a satisfyingly nutty crunch.
date.ingredients: Dates, psyllium husk, walnuts, almond butter, oat flour, cocoa butter, cinnamon, sea salt.
date.allergens: Contains nuts and oats (gluten). Sample allergen declaration; final formulation and cross-contact information pending.

pistachio.name: Pistachio
pistachio.description: Rounded pistachio flavour with a smooth, buttery finish.
pistachio.ingredients: Psyllium husk, pistachios, cocoa butter, almond butter, oat flour, chicory fibre, vanilla, sea salt.
pistachio.allergens: Contains nuts and oats (gluten). Sample allergen declaration; final formulation and cross-contact information pending.
